entries.title: WORLD OF HORROR
entries.definitive_edition: WORLD OF HORROR on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: WORLD OF HORROR launched its 1.0 release on Windows and macOS before the Switch and PlayStation console releases; Windows PC is the best capture/input route for the text-heavy roguelite horror interface.
primary.how_to_play: Buy WORLD OF HORROR on Steam, GOG, or itch.io for Windows PC and use the current full-release build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expanded definitive edition exists. Older Xbox/Microsoft Store Game Preview access is not treated as a final console release row because the final release includes PC/Mac, Switch, PS4, and PS5.
